description: Sync step 1. Lists published blog articles, side pages, landing pages and blog category hubs (type category, with url/path) that changed since a timestamp, oldest first. Loop: call with since=<serverTime from your last sync> (omit on first sync), export_* each returned item, then store the response's serverTime. Follow nextCursor while hasMore. Rows with status "unpublished" changed and are no longer public: remove them from your site. since is inclusive; re-delivery is harmless, dedupe by id + updatedAt/contentHash. Deleted items (including categories) arrive as { type, id, status: "deleted", previousUrls } tombstones on since-syncs. Also occasionally call with includeIds=true and delete anything on your site whose id is missing from publishedIds.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

includeIds.description: Also return the complete set of currently published ids per type, for deletion reconciliation.

since.description: ISO-8601; previous response's serverTime. Omit for a full initial sync.

types.description: Restrict to these types (default all four).

name: list_content_changes
